scope: development-only toy and Food-shaped implementation benchmark
prior_exploratory_work: A bounded kernel-only microcheck was used to verify implementation feasibility before this protocol. No selector ranking outcome was inspected.
prototype_objective: sum over classes and rows of squared Euclidean distance to the nearest prototype owned by the same class
initialization: deterministic per-class sample without replacement using SeedSequence(seed,class_position,class_count,k)

methods.current_nolloyd: float32 current class-wise sklearn MiniBatchKMeans, capped-32 relevance, fast OI scorer, no final weighted Lloyd
methods.looped_fixed3: per-class custom three-step full-batch Lloyd, capped-32 relevance, fast OI scorer
methods.fused_fixed3: padded class-batched custom three-step full-batch Lloyd, capped-32 relevance, fast OI scorer
methods.linear_probe: three-fold LogisticRegression comparator from the frozen diagonal-metric toy

ranking_toy.success: fused regret no more than 1 accuracy point worse than current_nolloyd in each scenario

food_shaped_prototype_benchmark.success: fused_fixed3 median wall time less than current_sklearn at every feature count

interpretation: Passing is evidence to justify a frozen Food-101 screen, not promotion or a public implementation change.
